claim_tested: Residue equivalent to ACCSL 529 is the substrate alpha-carboxylate ligand
key_finding: Apple ACS Arg407Lys: precipitous drop in kcat/Km, >=20-fold higher Km for AdoMet; Lys273Ala abolishes activity
context: Recombinant apple ACC synthase, E. coli expression, coupled kinetic assay
confidence: High for plant ACS; transfer to ACCSL is by homology only

claim_tested: Loss of the conserved fold-type I substrate arginine cripples catalysis
key_finding: E. coli AspAT R386Y and R386F reduce apparent second-order rate constant by >5 orders of magnitude
context: E. coli aspartate aminotransferase, kinetics + 2.5 A structure of R386F
confidence: High; different enzyme, same invariant position

claim_tested: Fold-type I catalytic residue set of ACC synthase
key_finding: Tomato ACS structures with PLP (1IAX) and PLP+AVG (1IAY); catalytic residues conserved; Tyr152 implicated in catalysis

claim_tested: ACS and AspAT share fold and active site despite 15% identity
key_finding: 2.4 A apple ACS structure; fold and active site very similar to AspAT

claim_tested: SAM binding mode in ACC synthase
key_finding: Covalent oxime of SAM analogue AMA with PLP defines the substrate subsite

claim_tested: ACS is a dimer with AVG ketimine in the shared active site
key_finding: 1.6 A apple ACS-AVG ketimine complex; Kd 10-20 pM
Asymmetric unit is a 94 kDa ACS dimer

claim_tested: ACCSL AlphaFold model superposes on PLP-bound ACS and accommodates PLP
key_finding: 306/407 core CA at 1.27 A on 1IAX; Lys395 NZ-C4A 2.65 A, Arg403-phosphate 2.81 A, Ser394 3.01 A, Asn330 3.19 A, Asp358-N1 3.55 A; no clash >rotamer level; pLDDT 89-98 at all contacts
confidence: Model-based; no experimental ACCSL structure exists

stance: refutes seed assumption of a Cys reference
claim_tested: Identity and frequency of residue 529 in humans
key_finding: rs2074051 p.Cys529Arg; Arg AF 0.7586 (gnomAD v4.1 exomes), 0.794 (1000G ALL); reference Cys is the minor allele; mouse/rat/bovine/chimp carry Arg
context: EBI Proteins API variation VAR_060626; Ensembl 1000G phase 3; UniProt orthologs
confidence: High for frequency; primate reference genomes are single alleles

claim_tested: Residue 529 geometry relative to the substrate site
key_finding: ACCSL Cys529 CA/CB within 0.47/0.62 A of tomato Arg412 CA/CB; tomato Arg412 NH2 is 3.27 A from AVG, ACCSL Cys529 SG is 7.83 A; residue 529 is 14.8 A from the modelled dimer interface
context: Superposed AF model + transplanted AVG from 1IAY

claim_tested: Is the ACCSL active site assembled at a dimer interface
key_finding: Apple-ACS two-fold gives 1586 inter-subunit contacts; Tyr204*, Trp207*, Tyr423* reach the cofactor site; 70 sub-2.2 A pairs indicate the rigid-body model needs relaxation
confidence: Low-moderate; rigid-body docking, not a predicted multimer

key_finding: Tomato Arg157->Phe272, Leu53->Thr175, Ala54->Ser176; phosphate loop GAT->GCC; Asn131->Phe246; all shared by mouse/rat Accsl and human/mouse ACCS
context: Alignment of 5 mammalian ACCS-family proteins to tomato ACS

claim_tested: ACCSL lacks residues necessary for activity
key_finding: CAUTION, ECO:0000305: 'lacks a number of residues which are necessary for activity thus suggesting that it lacks enzymatic activity'; recommended name 'Probable inactive ACC synthase-like protein 2'

claim_tested: Human ACCSL is a pseudoenzyme because residue 529 is Cys, not the ACS substrate-carboxylate Arg
key_finding: hACCS R457C (mimicking ACCSL Cys529) loses 100-fold activity; hACCS R351Y (mimicking ACCSL Tyr423) loses ~40-fold; authors conclude hACCSL 'is either a pseudoenzyme as predicted, or it possess a totally different function'. hACCSL itself was never assayed.
context: Recombinant human ACCS, in vitro ACC/2-oxobutyrate assays; AlphaFold2 model of hACCSL
confidence: High for the hACCS mutagenesis; the hACCSL inference is indirect. Premise that Cys529 is the human residue is wrong at the population level (see gnomAD row).

claim_tested: A mammalian ACS homolog can retain PLP while lacking ACC synthase activity
key_finding: Purified recombinant human ACCS/PHACS contains bound PLP but does not catalyse ACC synthesis; it deaminates L-vinylglycine (C-S lyase-like chemistry).
context: Recombinant human ACCS expressed in Pichia pastoris
confidence: High. Paralog, not ACCSL itself; establishes PLP binding and ACC synthase activity are separable in this family.

claim_tested: Cys529 is the residue present in human ACCSL
key_finding: rs2074051 p.Cys529Arg AF 0.760197 (AC 1226592 / AN 1613518). Arg529 is the major allele in all sampled populations; Cys529 is the ~24% minor allele. Only common coding variant in ACCSL.
confidence: High. Allele frequency is a direct observation; its functional consequence is inferred.

claim_tested: ACCSL behaves like an essential enzyme-coding gene
key_finding: LOEUF 1.117, o/e LoF 0.892, pLI 3.4e-17, 55 observed vs 61.7 expected pLoF; 145 distinct pLoF alleles but max AF 0.00235, so no common null. No common variation at any PLP-contacting residue (threshold AF 1e-4).
confidence: Moderate. Low constraint is weak evidence against essentiality; power is limited for a 568-aa gene with restricted expression.

claim_tested: Existing GO annotations give independent support for ACCSL transaminase activity
key_finding: Q4AC99 carries GO:0008483 (IBA, PANTHER PTN002887088 seeded by Arabidopsis ACS), GO:0030170 (IEA, InterPro IPR004839), GO:0006520 (IBA). No ACCSL annotation rests on a human experiment. Q96QU6 carries GO:0016847 with NOT qualifier, IDA, from PMID:11470512.
confidence: High for the provenance itself. Shows plant-to-human orthology transfer, not independent evidence.
